era: Target.com 2019 (Wayback captures Mar and Sep 2019 of the home page, Jul 2019 category and product, Dec 2019 search, rendered with their CSS; Arquivo Nov 2019 home for labels): red #cc0000 header bar with the white bullseye, Categories / Deals / Trending (Gifting in December) / Same Day Delivery menus, a white rounded search field, Sign in and cart; white sub-bar with 'You're shopping: <store>' and Registries & Lists, Weekly Ad, REDcard, Gift Cards, Find Stores, Orders, favourites and More; footer with collapsed Help / Stores / Apps / Social / More sections and a legal row (Recalls, Terms, Interest-Based Ads, CA Privacy Rights, CA Supply Chain Act, Privacy). Target had no dark design.
